item.author: Cannix Yau
item.dc:creator: Cannix Yau
item.description:
Hong Kong’s evenings are drawing in, with darkness falling by about 5.40pm as the city enters its earliest sunset period of the year. The Hong Kong Observatory said on Wednesday that the stretch began on November 24, with sunsets of 5.38pm or earlier continuing until December 2. Although the winter solstice falls on December 22, Hong Kong’s earliest sunsets usually occur in late November, while its latest sunrises do not arrive until mid-January, according to the Observatory.
“Many people...
item.title: From dawn to dusk: why Hong Kong’s early sunsets beat the winter solstice

item.author: Kyodo
item.dc:creator: Kyodo
item.description: A bicycle parking lot attendant was fatally stabbed in Fukuoka, southwestern Japan, on Wednesday, and a nearby shopping centre was evacuated after the attacker fled the scene, police said. The police later arrested Norio Kawatani, a 49-year-old resident of Fukuoka, for allegedly hitting a man at a subway station in the city. They are questioning him about his possible connection to the attendant’s death. The victim was identified as Yoshiaki Ishikawa, 70, who lived in the neighbourhood. He was...

item.description: The United States has proposed additional tariffs on 14 economies, including China, just a week after Chinese President Xi Jinping’s meeting with his US counterpart Donald Trump in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen. The new tariffs proposed on Wednesday over excess industrial capacity would add to existing 10 or 12.5 per cent duties imposed in July over forced labour, bringing total levies on targeted economies to between 15 and 20 per cent. People’s Liberation Army newspaper PLA Daily showed the growing use of manned-unmanned teaming (MUM-T) simulation training systems that feature support from accompanying drones, as well as AI-enhanced simulated battle conditions. item.description: In its travel advisories, the US State Department warns Americans not to visit Honduras’ Gracias a Dios region, alerting them to violent crime, armed robbery, murder and active terrorist groups.
